subject: general
question: Each of the digits in the number 6243514 is arranged in ascending order from left to right. What will be the sum of the digits which are second from the left and third from the right in the new number thus formed?
solution:
• Original Number:

 
 
• 6243514
 
 
 
 
• Rearrange in Ascending Order (Left to Right):
 
 
• 1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6
 
 
 
 
• Identify the Target Digits:
 
 
• Second from the left: 2 (1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6)
 
• Third from the right: 4 (1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6)
 
 
 
 
• Calculate the Sum:
 
 
• 2 + 4 = 6
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
